title: International Chemistry Tournament — one national team

applicability.notes: This ruleset models one 4–6 person national team. Reporter, Opponent, and Reviewer are round assignments held by different teams, not three teammates.

required_roles.title: captain and round coordinator
duties: Nominate the active speaker and manage challenges, refusals, and the permitted timeout.

required_roles.title: scientific lead
duties: Develop the chemical argument and verify experimental claims against available evidence.

required_roles.title: evidence and integrity reviewer
duties: Check that claims, calculations, and cited evidence are defensible before presentation.

required_roles.title: opposition-preparation strategist
duties: Prepare the team for likely opposition without impersonating the external opposing team.

fill_role.title: team scientist
duties: Contribute analysis, slide evidence, and answers for jury questioning.

turn_budget.derivation: The seven timed oral segments total roughly 35 minutes; turns do not reproduce speech clocks.

state_requirements.description: Reporter, Opponent, Reviewer, and optional Observer are different teams in the same fight.
The active speaker cannot communicate with teammates except during the permitted timeout.
Monologues, discussions, jury questions, and general discussion have separate clocks.

presentation_device.conditions: One laptop or tablet may display a single slideshow file; no other files or windows may be opened.

constraints.statement: A national team contains four to six high-school students.
Teams rotate through Reporter, Opponent, Reviewer, and sometimes Observer assignments across rounds.
Only the captain-nominated active speaker speaks for the team and normally cannot consult teammates during the round.
The runner records a written report and opposition-preparation artifact instead of conducting a multi-team oral fight.

collaboration.notes: Internal opposition preparation is allowed, but the official Opponent and Reviewer remain external teams.

submission.official_deliverable: live oral report, opposition, review, slides, and jury answers
submission.adaptation: Live multi-team oral performance and slide delivery are flattened into text.

evaluation.notes: A valid evaluator needs multiple jurors, oral timing, slides, and cross-team interaction.

waivers.official_rule: A fight contains three or four distinct teams with adversarial round roles.
waivers.benchmark_treatment: The draft resolves one national team and treats opponents as external.

sources.title: IChTo 2025 Rule Book
sources.locator: Team composition, fight roles, timing, devices, and Internet rules
